subject: Request to stretch trial window and apply short-term credits for scheduler-adapter holdout
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@paylink.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PayLink trial — scheduler adapter failing during ledger sync

Hi Connor,

Quick update from our eng team: the scheduler-adapter that kicks off daily ledger syncs is intermittently failing when calling Redwood's hosted endpoint. The failure happens in our QA env when payload sizes exceed ~120KB — we suspect a chunking/config mismatch. We've spent the last two days debugging with our SREs and have a temporary workaround, but the integration won't be stable enough for our demo next week.

Given this, can you confirm if PayLink can get a 2-week extension on the trial window plus a small credit (we're ~70% through initial tokens) so we don't run out mid-testing? We want to keep momentum with the PM and engineering leadership.

Attached is a short snippet from our logs and the failing request headers. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director of Integrations, PayLink

--
attachment: integration-log-snippet.txt (text)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@paylink.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PayLink trial — scheduler adapter failing during ledger sync

Samantha — thanks for the detail and the log snippet.

Quick notes from our side:
- We see the 120KB threshold you mentioned can trigger an unexpected payload split on some clients. Our hosted endpoint has a per-request payload limit but can be tuned; Marissa (SE) can test a quantized payload mode and a prefix cache flag that often resolves this.
- For the ask: a 2-week trial stretch + a 10k token credit top-up is a reasonable accommodation while you stabilize the adapter. I'll start internal approval threads now; I copied Marissa and Kim who handle SE & commercial approvals.

Can you share the demo date and whether Tom (your infra lead) can join a 30-min troubleshooting call tomorrow at 10am PT? If we can reproduce the error with your QA payload, Marissa can propose an immediate config change.

Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
P: 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T14:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PayLink trial — scheduler adapter failing during ledger sync

Connor / Kim — read the logs. Two quick options to unblock PayLink:

1) Short term: extend trial by 14 days and apply a 10,000 token sandbox credit. SE can enable payload chunk-accept heuristics and a relaxed Content-Length guard for their account. Risk minimal for hosted; revert after testing.

2) If they need a more durable fix, we can recommend a client-side chunking shim + enable prefix caching (this reduces token usage for repeated requests). That would be a longer config/SDK task.

I vote yes on option 1 to keep momentum. Kim, do we need manager approval for a 10k token promo against PL-2028-083? If yes, I'll draft the short approval note and attach the proposed milestone plan.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer

--
attachment: proposed-milestone-plan.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha@paylink.io>
Date: 2028-06-20T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PayLink trial — scheduler adapter failing during ledger sync

Hi all — following internal review, we can approve a 14-day trial extension and a one-time 10,000 token sandbox credit for PayLink (deal PL-2028-083). Conditions:

- The extension begins on 2028-06-20 and ends 2028-07-04.
- Marissa will temporarily enable the relaxed payload guard and monitor error rates for 48 hours; we'll revert if we see degradation.
- PayLink should schedule the 30-min troubleshooting session so we can walk through the reproducer.
- Please confirm acceptance and update the HubSpot deal with the applied credit and revised close timeline.

Samantha — Connor/Marissa will set the call. If you'd like the credit formalized via a short one-line addendum, we can put that in DocuSign; let me know.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Onwards — Connor, can you send the acceptance and the calendar invite?
